name: Primal Rite
label: Revelation
lede: A San Francisco band fronted by Lucy X put out a promo tape and two seven-inches in 2016, then landed on Revelation with a 7" and a debut LP.

eras.title: Three records in one year
eras.text: Primal Rite came out of San Francisco's hardcore scene all at once: a numbered promo tape, then two seven-inches, one right after the other.

years.p: Primal Rite start with a limited, hand-numbered promo tape, the San Francisco band's first release.

years.h: Hatred in a Mask of Flowers / Pestilent Clutch 7"
years.p: Two songs on a 45, Primal Rite's first vinyl.
play: Hatred in a Mask of Flowers / Pestilent Clutch
Hatred in a Mask of Flowers

years.p: Primal Rite's second 7" of 2016, also issued on cassette.

eras.title: On Revelation
eras.text: Revelation had spent thirty years as the home of New York straight edge and its descendants. In 2017 and 2018 it put out a Primal Rite 7" and the San Francisco band's first full-length.

years.h: Primal Rite sign to Revelation: Sensory Link to Pain
years.p: Three songs as Revelation REV 169: Sensory Link to Pain, Is It Me? and Primal Discipline. Lucy X sings, Jake Dudley and Jason Brownstein play guitar, Max Wickham bass, Jeremy Meier drums.
years.xp: Revelation's pressing notes list 10 test pressings, then 330 on opaque yellow and 700 on black for the first press.

years.h: Full set filmed by hate5six, June 10, 2017
yt: Full set filmed by hate5six, June 10, 2017

years.h: Dirge of Escapism, Primal Rite's first album · Revelation
years.p: Primal Rite's debut LP. Revelation pressed it in three colors: 167 blue, 327 black and 700 red, plus 11 test pressings, with a CD alongside.

years.h: Bow to No One: a shaped flexi-disc
years.p: Primal Rite release Bow to No One as a limited 7" flexi cut into a shape rather than a circle.
